annotation.title_clean: The Government of Spain approves the Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2024
annotation.title_en: The Government of Spain approves the Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2024
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government of Spain, La Moncloa (Council of Ministers)
annotation.summary_en: Government press page on the Council of Ministers' 14 May 2024 approval of Spain's AI Strategy 2024. It describes €1.5bn funding, supercomputing, the ALIA Spanish-language model, talent, public-administration pilots, and cybersecurity. It also covers ethical and transparent AI aligned with the EU AI Act and AESIA. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Strategy 2024-2025 funded with €1.5bn from the Recovery Plan, on top of €600m already mobilised
ALIA foundation language models in Spanish and co-official languages, with transparency and openness
€90m investment in MareNostrum supercomputing; sustainable data centres under environmental standards
€160m for AI scholarships and training; pilots and common data governance in public administration
AESIA to supervise AI and promote ethical, humanistic AI in line with the EU AI Act
